snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Echo of Dawn Preview Video
snippet.description:
GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Echo of Dawn

Time-Limited Event [Echo of Dawn] will be open from June 12. During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Targeted Access Permissions], [Basic Info Cores] by participating in event Game Modes.

[Duration] 
2025/6/12 09:00 - 2025/7/2 18:59(GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 2025/7/9 18:59(GMT+0)

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20
